summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for current transformer with two secondaries, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: This CT form identifies two documented secondary windings on a common magnetic circuit. Separate secondary connection paths must remain visible so a reader can follow their respective meters or relays without assuming independent cores.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Check loading and terminal data for both secondary circuits.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Two secondary windings on a common magnetic circuit differ from two independently specified protection cores.
